title: Strong and Explicit Forms of the One-Sided Nullstellensatz over Division Rings
summary: We establish strong and explicit forms of a one-sided Nullstellensatz for polynomial rings D[x1, . . . , xn] over arbitrary division rings D with central indeterminates. To this end, we employ the theory of integral dependence over left ideals and the notion of G-left ideals, which plays a role analogous to that of G-ideals in the classical theory. We prove that the Jacobson radical of any left ideal of D[x1, . . . , xn] coincides with the intersection of all G-left ideals containing it.
